verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server (trivy-mcp) that advertises natural-language querying of security issues and was confirmed working via a real handshake test, enabling agentic/AI-native use through MCP-enabled tools like VS Code. However, Trivy's core interface remains a traditional CLI with structured flags/JSON output rather than native NL commands, so the NL capability is an add-on plugin rather than the primary interaction mode.
